summary: Reports critical CVEs (CVE-2026-33815, CVE-2026-33816, CVE-2026-33186) in temporalio/server and temporalio/admin-tools 1.30.4 Docker images. The vulnerability was addressed with v1.30.4.1 release containing security patches.
userImpact: Users of temporalio/server:1.30.4 and temporalio/admin-tools:1.30.4 Docker images are exposed to critical security vulnerabilities until upgrading to patched versions.
rootCause: Dependency vulnerabilities in production Docker images, specifically critical CVEs in underlying libraries like PGX.
proposedFix: Release patched Docker images with updated dependencies; v1.30.4.1 was released with security patches.
resolutionDetails: Released v1.30.4.1 with security patches addressing the reported CVEs.
keyQuote: We have released v1.30.4.1 with this security patch.
